steps.en: Install, point config at any OpenAI-compatible endpoint
steps.zh: 安装，把配置指向任一 OpenAI 兼容接口

steps.en: Create the memory, feed dialogue turns with timestamps
steps.zh: 建记忆实例，带时间戳喂入对话

steps.en: Distills each turn into compact self-contained memory units
steps.zh: 把每轮对话蒸馏成紧凑自包含的记忆单元

steps.en: Merges related units online, indexes them in embedded LanceDB
steps.zh: 在线合并相关记忆，索引进内嵌的 LanceDB

steps.en: Finalize, then ask in plain language
steps.zh: 结束写入，用自然语言提问

steps.en: Plans retrieval around the question's intent, assembles a compact answer
steps.zh: 按问题意图规划检索，拼出紧凑答案

value.en: Past interactions stay recallable without replaying raw history into the context
value.zh: 过去的交互随时可召回，不用把原始历史重放进上下文

sources: https://github.com/aiming-lab/SimpleMem README Quick Start (from simplemem import SimpleMem; mem.add_dialogue(...); mem.finalize(); mem.ask(...))
